> This extension is superseded by [Code Window](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-code-window), which labels code blocks by default.

Enabling the filter is the whole of the setup: the language comes from the class Quarto already puts on the block.

```r
summary(cars)
```

```python
print(sum(range(10)))
```

A `filename` attribute replaces the label:

```{.r filename="analysis.R"}
summary(cars)
```

A block with no language has nothing to show, and is left alone.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-language-cell-decorator/>.
